eyebrow: What a real AAR contains, part one

steps.label: Incident timeline
steps.sub: first indicator through recovery completion, in one timezone

steps.label: Root cause
steps.sub: the actual underlying cause, not just the symptom that alerted

steps.label: Impact
steps.sub: systems, data, downtime, cost, and any reporting obligations

steps.label: Response actions taken
steps.sub: what the team actually did, in plain, followable steps

steps.label: What worked / didn't
steps.sub: the lessons learned meeting's findings, now in the record

steps.label: Action items
steps.sub: the part that actually changes anything

eyebrow: An action item needs an owner and a date
code:
FAILS:
"Improve logging."

WORKS:
"Jordan (Platform team) configures
MFA-status API read access for
the SOC by the 15th."
caption: No owner and no deadline means it isn't an action item — it's a wish.
